areas.name: Downtown
areas.blurb: Fort Bragg's walkable old town along Main and Franklin Streets from Oak to Fir, with the Skunk Train depot, Laurel and Redwood shops, cafes and galleries.

areas.name: North Main & Glass Beach
areas.blurb: North Main Street from Fir Street past Pudding Creek: motels, diners, a brewery and lumber yard, steps from Glass Beach and the Coastal Trail.

areas.name: South Main Street
areas.blurb: Highway 1 from Oak Street down to the Noyo Bridge: supermarkets, pharmacies, motels and drive-ins, with the hospital and clinics a block east.

areas.name: Noyo Harbor
areas.blurb: The working fishing harbor at the mouth of the Noyo River, below the Highway 1 bridge: seafood restaurants, fish markets, charters and inns on North and South Harbor Drive.

areas.name: Boatyard & Highway 20
areas.blurb: South of the Noyo River: the Boatyard Shopping Center, the Highway 20 junction and the road east toward Willits, and Highway 1 south to the Botanical Gardens.

areas.name: Cleone & MacKerricher
areas.blurb: Highway 1 north of town: Cleone, Lake Cleone and MacKerricher State Park, with campgrounds, Laguna Point and the coastal haul road.

areas.name: Around Fort Bragg
areas.blurb: Neighborhood spots elsewhere in Fort Bragg and ZIP 95437, from the east-side hills to Pudding Creek Road and the Noyo River valley.
